assertions: `swissknifeman` is the umbrella repository and control layer

Keep `core/` as shared stdlib primitives, the five package roots as independent tools, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` as the generated umbrella marketplace, and `docs/` as the aggregated documentation site.
Read the relevant package guide before changing `packages/<name>/`
`task` remains plugin-only and has no standalone CLI.
Use `swissknifeman skills|env|maind|analyst|setup|doctor` as the root router
keep `skiller`, `harness`, `maind`, and `analyst` as distinct package CLIs, and do not add a root `task` group.
package Python runtime stays stdlib-only and reaches `core` through the repository `PYTHONPATH` fallback.
Maintain one generated `swissknifeman` marketplace with package provenance
plugin names remain unprefixed for backward compatibility.

Do not add pip/npm runtime dependencies, duplicate shared primitives, rename the umbrella or `~/.swissknifeman/` state, break embedded `maind` paths, or roll out always-on context without the budget gate.
Keep executable master plans in repository `plans/<ID>/` and use the `plan-protocol` schema and commands.
Run the affected package validation command before handoff and use Russian Conventional Commit messages.
Record external design sources in `docs/reference.md`, vendor provenance in adjacent `upstream.json`, and deliberately rejected recurring ideas in `docs/rejected-optimizations.md`.
verify repository claims by reading code and recorded evidence.
Keep Claude Code compatibility surfaces in this extension: `.claude*`, `CLAUDE.md`, existing plugin commands, and managed Claude hooks remain provider-owned.
target 3–7K, warn at 10K, and require an Owner verdict above the gate.
For Claude Code research, use the established `perplexity-web` route before `WebSearch`
this native routing does not replace the common external-claim verification rule.

Treat `.agents/skills/*` as thin Codex adapters, keep canonical skill and command content under `packages/skiller/skills/` and `packages/task/commands/`, use worktree-local package CLIs for writes, and preserve Claude Code compatibility.
For this trusted repository, a Codex launch names the repository cwd, routed model and effort, `-a never`, and `-s danger-full-access`

preflight checks `pwd`, `git status --short`, `codex doctor --json`, hook integrity, `maind health --cwd`, and applicable plan lint. Treat hook exit `127` as a path defect and repair its effective registration.
For an active executable plan, delegate each next executable item from its committed handoff
fix audit regressions forward through the owning item and escalate only an authority or frozen-contract change.
`skiller` is the registry and source of truth for portable AI skills
it distributes skills without becoming the umbrella control layer.
Keep the two distribution channels distinct: `connect` enables a marketplace source, while `vendor`/`sync` delivers managed physical skill copies.
Keep `.swissknife.json` for connect and legacy vendor selection separate from `.swissknifeman/config.json` for skill-granular vendor sync.
Deliver the nine `CORE_SKILLS` by default through the selected channel
`--no-core` is the explicit opt-out and budget reporting remains authoritative.
treat `skills.json`, `skills/_index.md`, marketplace manifests, graph, and budget documentation as registry-generated outputs.
Keep skill selection in `config.resolve_selection`, vendor sync in `skillset.do_sync`, and environment preset ownership delegated to `harness`.

Keep `lib/` stdlib-only, pass frozen `Env` explicitly, use Russian diagnostics and merge-only project writes, and edit local skills through `SKILL.ru.md` before regenerating the compact English canon.
Before release run `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/validate.sh`
after skill or bucket changes run `skiller registry` and use Russian Conventional Commit messages.
Claude Code `connect` writes `enabledPlugins` to `.claude/settings.local.json` and points the marketplace channel at the registry rather than copying skill bodies.
Claude Code vendor sync writes managed copies to `.claude/skills/` and records ownership in `skills-lock.json`
those files are committed for disconnected consumers.
Claude Code loads skill bodies itself
`hub.py` remains the managed agent-hub generator and Python does not maintain a skill-body loading cache.
`harness` configures project environments with permissions, MCP, hooks, output styles, plan-directory settings, and agent packs.
Keep `configs/claude-code/` as the current Claude compatibility source and keep common/provider semantic catalogs explicit rather than inferring settings from target files.
Keep `bin/harness` as the thin launcher, `lib/harness/` as stdlib-only logic, `configs/` as source configuration, and `tests/` isolated in temporary directories.
Keep the CLI surface `permissions`, `mcp`, `hooks`, `router`, `agent-packs`, `safe-dirs`, and `doctor`, with explicit `--target` and dry-run behavior where defined.
Agent packs render templates, upgrade only safe managed files, write conflicts as `*.pack-new`, and remove only unmodified managed files
Keep `lib/harness/` stdlib-only, pass frozen `Env` explicitly, use merge-only project writes with `*.bak` backups, and emit Russian diagnostics.
Keep memory state ownership with `skiller`, retain `.swissknife.json:memory_brain`, and let `skiller` delegate environment operations to the worktree-local `harness` launcher.
Run `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/validate.sh` before release
regenerate the umbrella registry after changing harness plugin commands.
Claude Code configuration remains under `configs/claude-code/`: settings presets merge into `.claude/settings*.json` and MCP presets merge into `.mcp.json`.
Claude Code lifecycle surfaces include `PreToolUse` auto-approval, memory, notify, router, run-report, output style, and project `plansDirectory` registrations.
Claude Code keeps `outputStyle` in `.claude/settings.local.json`, uses top-level `plansDirectory` in `.claude/settings.json`, and keeps the agent-pack lock at `.claude/agent-pack.lock.json`.
`maind` is the ecosystem control-plane hub for shared memory, cross-project graph data, project and agent registries, and its MCP server.
Keep agent-memory, the maind federation graph, and the Serena code graph as independent planes
they meet only in orchestration and remain namespace-isolated.
Keep `bin/maind` as the launcher, `lib/maind/` as stdlib-only logic, `provision/` and `analysis/` as named subpackages, and tests independent of a live daemon.
Read graph data through `federation.graph_reader`, derive graph facts from sources of truth, and retain canonical adapters `federation` or `disabled` with legacy aliases normalized.
Keep memory, graph, and code-graph modules decoupled
combine them only through onboarding, sync, and orchestration entry points.
Keep `lib/maind/` stdlib-only, pass frozen `Env` explicitly, write JSON atomically, emit Russian diagnostics, and preserve `project:`, `ns:`, and `global` memory isolation.
Before release run `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/validate.sh`, then use Russian Conventional Commit messages.
The Claude Code plugin exposes only `/maind:*` command wrappers
maind MCP tools arrive through the per-project `maind` server in `.mcp.json`.
Claude Code workspace trust is managed by `workspace.py` in `.claude/settings.local.json` and remains separate from provider-agnostic hub state.
`analyst` is an on-demand, stdlib-only learning layer with no daemon
it may propose reusable knowledge but only a human may promote a lesson to curated state.
Keep this package as layer-1 data and pipeline work
prompt-discipline skills remain a separate layer and automatic skill writes are forbidden.
Keep `bin/analyst` as the launcher, `lib/analyst/` as stdlib-only logic, temporary-directory tests, and package documentation that builds standalone and in the umbrella site.
Keep extractors pure where possible, confine I/O to `cmd_*` paths, and keep proposal, suggestion, digest, review, promotion, confidence, and recompute responsibilities in their named modules.
Store lessons in explicit lifecycle directories, append audit and confidence events without rewriting them, and move lessons through `lessons.move_lesson` rather than duplicating state.
send only abstracted curated lessons to shared memory and reference secrets without storing their values.
Keep runtime stdlib-only, pass frozen `Env` explicitly, write JSON atomically, require human confirmation for curated promotion, and emit Russian diagnostics.
Before release run `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/validate.sh`
regenerate the umbrella registry after changing analyst plugin commands.
Claude Code capture reads project lessons from `.claude/analyst`, run reports from `.claude/runs`, and session transcripts from `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/*.jsonl`.
The Claude Code plugin exposes command-only `/analyst:*` wrappers and does not add a daemon or automatic promotion path.
`task` is the plugin-only package for task-intent commands and executable plan protocol
it has no `bin/`, standalone CLI, or installer.
Keep the intent command catalog `design`, `dev`, `fix`, `research`, and `review` alongside `plan-design`, `plan-exec`, `plan-run`, `plan-close`, and `plan-audit`.
plan-design, plan-exec, plan-close, and plan-audit remain the protocol’s authoring, execution, closure, and independent-review layers.
Keep command Markdown in `commands/`, the deterministic plan linter in `lib/task/plan_lint.py`, its launcher in `scripts/plan-lint.py`, and isolated tests in `tests/`.
Treat `plan_lint.py` and the `plan-protocol` skill as synchronized sources of the plan schema
change both when the schema changes.
Keep `lib/task/` stdlib-only, retain deliberate plugin-only delivery outside root CLI routing, and use Russian diagnostics.
Before release run `bash packages/task/scripts/validate.sh` and use Russian Conventional Commit messages.

Claude Code exposes the catalog as `/task:design`, `/task:dev`, `/task:fix`, `/task:research`, `/task:review`, `/task:plan-design`, `/task:plan-exec`, `/task:plan-run`, `/task:plan-close`, and `/task:plan-audit`.
Claude Code command frontmatter pins model and effort for each task type
do not change those pins without explicit intent, while `plan-run` inherits the owner session route.
